headline: EV, Brand Additions and After-sales to Drive Growth

highlights: Revenue grew as festive demand factored in alongside the aftersales segment reporting a 12% YoY growth.
EBITDA stood at INR 832 Mn (+53% YoY and 8% QoQ), above our estimate of INR 768 Mn.
EBITDA margin stood at 5.7% inline with our forecast of 5.4% expanding 125 bps YoY & marginally contracting by -20 bps sequentially.
PAT stood at INR 185 Mn (up by 1131% YoY and 27% QoQ), inline with our estimate.
valuation: Operating cost discipline has permanently lowered employee expenses to 3.9% and other operating expenses to 3.4% of pro-forma revenue (comfortably under the 4% target).

Outlook and Valuation: We expect Landmark Cars Ltd to deliver healthy growth over FY27-29E, on the back of i) New brand empanelment’s ii) New launches iii) increasing After-sales penetration and iv)Higher EV after sales revenue per vehicle.
We value the company using a DCF-based methodology and arrive at a target price of INR 600/share(revised from INR 668).
watch: Investment Rationale After Sales Mix to Aid overall Sales Portfolio: The After-sales segment continues to remain a key contributor to margins, supported by a growing installed vehicle base and increasing workshop maturity.
EV After-Sales; a key lever: With EVs contributing ~29% of new car sales revenue in H1FY27.
